title: plugin-detail: inline-editing a multi-line `textarea` field on the record page saves it with its line breaks stripped (the row edits in a one-line INPUT of type text)
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect** with a named landing and a reproduction. Finding class (a). `reach:` named real producers (below). ⚠️ **Data integrity:** the save silently rewrites stored text.

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2`, seat post objectui#5560) from the out-of-scope finding in the objectui#11541 dev report (`5970452769`), and re-read by this seat at objectui `origin/main` `d0c0c7fe9`. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens
On the record page, `record:details` edit mode, a `textarea` field edits in `InlineFieldInput`'s terminal input. That input is a single-line INPUT element of type `text`.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx`: `'textarea'` is a member of `INLINE_PLAIN_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES` (`:81` at `d0c0c7fe9`), and the terminal element is an INPUT of type `text` carrying `data-testid={INLINE_PLAIN_TEXT_INPUT_TESTID}` (about `:556`–`:559`).
- An INPUT of type `text` strips line breaks from the value it is given; that is the HTML value-sanitization rule for the text type. The dev measured it in Chromium 141 and happy-dom: a multi-line value reads back with every line break removed.
- So a stored value with blank lines and a trailing newline is shown flattened, and one keystroke in that input makes the flattened string the value the Save batch writes. Nothing warns.

The drift guard (`__tests__/inlineEditTypeCoverage.test.tsx`) files `textarea` as "benign: stored value is already a string, nothing is lost" (objectui#4220's class D). That holds only for a single-line value. `InlineFieldInput.delegation.test.tsx` pins class D with single-line values only.

## Reach: named producers
- objectstack `examples/app-crm`, `lead.object.ts`: `notes: Field.textarea`.
- objectstack `examples/app-showcase`, `task.object.ts`: `notes: Field.textarea`.
- The hotcrm textarea fields objectstack-ai/objectstack#21543 measured. Its item 2 became objectui#11541.

Measured at the component level and in the browser engine, ⛔ not yet through a live record page. The landing is mechanical and named; see the precedent below.

## Precedent and likely landing (a lead, not a ruling)
PR objectui#11559 (objectui#11541, in review) routes `markdown` on the same row to the fields package's multi-line `TextAreaField`, through the detail-side carve-out `DETAIL_ROUTED_INLINE_TYPES`. It writes the `INLINE_PLAIN_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES` docblock note that `textarea` keeps this loss. That PR does ⛔ not change `textarea`. The likely fix routes `textarea` the same way, and the drift guard moves it from "benign" to "routed". A pin then saves a value with `\n\n` and a trailing newline, and reads it back byte-identical.

## Reader
Triage grades and routes it; the expected lane is `domain:ui` (`packages/plugin-detail`). objectui#11559's landing should come first, because both edit `InlineFieldInput.tsx` and the drift guard.

## Dedupe
- REST: the 300 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (back to 2026-10-01), grepped for `textarea … newline|line break`, `INLINE_PLAIN_TEXT`, `input type="text" … newline` (as a regex) and `line breaks stripped|lost`. Hits: only objectui#11559 and #11541. Control `plugin-detail`: 36 hits.
- MCP semantic search, repo-scoped: "textarea inline edit record details newlines line breaks stripped single-line input" → 10 hits, none this defect. objectui#4220 is the class-D classification this card shows is wrong for multi-line values.
- Dedupe words: textarea inline edit newlines stripped · record:details textarea single-line input · INLINE_PLAIN_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES textarea lossy · detail inline edit line breaks lost.
